project_title: The Story That Was Passed On
style_block: cinematic Ethiopian heritage realism, warm natural evening light, 35mm film aesthetic, muted earth tones, shallow depth of field

elder_01.name: The Elder
elder_01.description: A fictional Ethiopian elderly man, approximately 70 years old, kind expressive eyes, natural wrinkles, short grey hair, wearing a simple traditional white handwoven cotton gabi over a tunic.

child_01.name: The Child
child_01.description: A fictional Ethiopian child, approximately 10 years old, curious expressive eyes, short natural hair, wearing simple modest earth-toned traditional-inspired cotton clothing.

neighbour_01.name: The Neighbour
neighbour_01.description: A fictional frail elderly Ethiopian villager, weathered hands, wearing a worn beige cotton wrap.

music.prompt: warm, contemplative Ethiopian heritage instrumental, acoustic krar and masenqo, gentle strings, soft percussion, hopeful and reflective

shots.image_prompt: Wide landscape of a peaceful fictional Ethiopian highland village at sunset, traditional round thatched-roof tukuls along an empty dusty path, distant green hills, warm golden hour light, no people, no humans in frame.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle camera glide toward a small traditional home. Soft breeze moving tree leaves.
shots.narration: The Story That Was Passed On. In a quiet Ethiopian village, an elderly man carried many stories in his heart.
shots.subtitle: The Story That Was Passed On. In a quiet Ethiopian village, an elderly man carried many stories in his heart.

shots.image_prompt: An elderly Ethiopian man sitting beside a 10-year-old child on wooden stools outside a traditional home at dusk, warm glow of a small hearth fire, intimate composition.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle camera push toward the child as the child turns to look at the elder.
shots.narration: One evening, as the sun set, the child asked him a question.
shots.subtitle: One evening, as the sun set, the child asked him a question.
shots.music_cue: Music softens into a quiet underscore.

shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a curious 10-year-old Ethiopian child looking earnestly toward the elder, warm flickering firelight on face.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle natural blinking and slight head tilt. Stable camera.
shots.tts_style: curious young child asking a heartfelt question, natural and gentle
shots.narration: Grandfather, why do you always tell us the same old stories?
shots.subtitle: Grandfather, why do you always tell us the same old stories?

shots.purpose: Begin the story within the story
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the 70-year-old Ethiopian storyteller with a warm, gentle smile, soft firelight illuminating his wrinkled face and white cotton gabi.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow subtle push-in on the elder as he begins to speak. Gentle firelight flicker.
shots.narration: The elder smiled, and began telling a story about their village.
shots.subtitle: The elder smiled, and began telling a story about their village.

shots.image_prompt: Wide establishing landscape shot of a quiet Ethiopian highland village during a harsh dry season, cracked parched dirt path winding between traditional round thatched-roof tukuls, dry yellow grass, distant barren hills under pale afternoon sunlight, 35mm cinematic film still.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow panoramic pan across the dry, quiet village.
shots.narration: Years ago, a harsh dry season came to the land, and people began to worry.
shots.subtitle: Years ago, a harsh dry season came to the land, and people began to worry.
shots.music_cue: Music shifts to a slightly tense, serious tone.

shots.purpose: Show the child's act of kindness
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of a 10-year-old Ethiopian child outside a modest village home offering a small woven basket of injera to a frail elderly neighbour, warm natural light.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle camera movement following the child stepping forward with the food.
shots.narration: Yet one child shared the little food they had with a struggling neighbour.
shots.subtitle: Yet one child shared the little food they had with a struggling neighbour.
shots.music_cue: A warmer, hopeful melodic theme enters.

shots.purpose: Insert shot of hands revealing the turning point
shots.image_prompt: Extreme macro close-up looking down at dark-skinned weathered elderly hands carefully placing one single heirloom grain seed into a child's small open palm, warm golden sunlight, shallow depth of field, no faces visible.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle push-in toward the seed resting in the child's palm.
shots.narration: In return, the neighbour gave the child a single seed saved for planting.
shots.subtitle: In return, the neighbour gave the child a single seed saved for planting.

shots.purpose: Resolve the story within the story
shots.image_prompt: Several fictional Ethiopian villagers and the child kneeling together in morning sunlight, planting a green seedling in dark moist soil and pouring water from a clay pot.
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle movement of hands pressing soil around the seedling. Calm, steady camera.
shots.narration: Together, the village planted that seed, watered it, and watched it grow.
shots.subtitle: Together, the village planted that seed, watered it, and watched it grow.
shots.music_cue: Music rises into an uplifting arrangement.

shots.image_prompt: Return to the evening fireside: the 70-year-old storyteller looking kindly at the 10-year-old child who is listening deeply, warm evening firelight.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera push toward the child's thoughtful expression.
shots.tts_style: warm wise elderly grandfather speaking gently, unhurried
shots.narration: My child, what matters is not when a story happened, but what it teaches us.
shots.subtitle: My child, what matters is not when a story happened, but what it teaches us.
shots.music_cue: Music softens for the intimate closing exchange.

shots.image_prompt: The 10-year-old child animatedly speaking by the warm evening fire as the elderly man listens and smiles proudly beside the hearth, warm cinematic closing frame.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow smooth camera pullback, settling into a peaceful still composition.
shots.narration: And so the lesson lived on: when a story is passed on, a generation carries it forward.
shots.subtitle: And so the lesson lived on: when a story is passed on, a generation carries it forward.
